title: don't buy if you are buying for the lid.
text: don't buy if you are buying for the lid.. I got this so when I make my pasta free lasagna i could take it to parties.  The lid is a total joke it just sits on top of the pan.  Foil or cling wrap works much better.  By sit on top I mean it doesn't snap on.  I like the pan a lot I give the pan 5 stars but I bought it for the lid which is a 1 (0) star so i split the difference.  The spatula is really just a joke.  It is the perfect size and depth for a lasagna pan.
